title: Expose Dedicated scaling policy (min/max bounds + predictive mode) in modules and examples
author: Irene Choi
description: This PR updates the redwood-terraform modules and example configs to support the new Dedicated autoscaling policy fields (customer-configurable min/max bounds + predictive mode toggle). The provider/resource schema changes landed in the redwood monorepo; this PR focuses on surfacing the knobs in our Terraform modules, keeping backward compatibility (no behavior change unless fields are set), and documenting expected semantics + feature-flag requirements for predictive mode. Key updates: (1) Dedicated module: add optional inputs for scaling policy (min_replicas, max_replicas, scale_up_cooldown_seconds, scale_down_cooldown_seconds, predictive_mode, predictive_lead_time_seconds). (2) Examples: add a dedicated_deployment example showing cost ceiling + baseline capacity, and an example enabling predictive mode for known daily ramps. (3) Docs: README updates describing precedence (bounds clamp desired replicas), validation (min <= max), and operational notes (predictive mode requires account flag; reactive scaling still applies when forecasts are stale). (4) Outputs: expose effective scaling policy fields in outputs for visibility during plan/apply and for CI drift checks. Notes: predictive_mode is intentionally an opt-in boolean and defaults to false/null to preserve existing behavior; modules use null defaults and conditional blocks to avoid forcing zero-values into the API.

test_plan: 1) terraform fmt (repo root) 2) terraform validate for modules/dedicated and each example directory 3) plan-only run against staging workspace using a sandbox Dedicated deployment (no-op expected when scaling policy fields are unset) 4) apply in staging with min/max set (verify bound fields appear in state and API reflects values) 5) plan/apply with predictive_mode=true only in accounts with feature flag enabled (verify API accepts; otherwise expect validation error from control plane).
rollout_notes: No automatic customer behavior change: module defaults keep scaling policy unset unless explicitly configured. Predictive mode requires enablement via internal process (INT-9412) and is documented as such. Recommend rolling this out to pilot accounts first; include module version bump in pilot customer IaC repos before broader comms.
review_conversation: Ethan Park: Can we avoid sending zero-values for cooldowns when the user doesn’t set them? Control plane treats 0 as 'immediate', which is not what we want for defaults. Also please document that predictive_mode is gated per account.

Irene Choi (author): Updated to use null defaults + conditional block rendering so we only send fields that are set. Added README note: predictive_mode requires account flag + forecasts must be fresh; otherwise autoscaler falls back to reactive while respecting bounds.

Vanessa Ortiz: Please align naming with the control plane schema (min_replicas/max_replicas) and add an example showing a hard max as a budget ceiling. Also add a short note that max-bound saturation will show up as queueing/latency if traffic exceeds cap.

Irene Choi (author): Renamed variables to min_replicas/max_replicas (keeping old names as deprecated aliases was considered, but we never shipped them). Added examples/dedicated-scaling-bounds and a README callout about max-bound saturation impacts.

Kira Thompson: Docs read well. Can you add a small troubleshooting section pointing to the Dedicated autoscaler runbook/dashboards for 'why didn’t it scale above max?' and 'why is predictive not doing anything?'

Irene Choi (author): Added a short troubleshooting section with links and the two common cases: hitting max bound and forecasts stale/flag disabled. Also clarified that reactive signals can override prediction (within bounds).
Allison Grant: Please be explicit about which metrics customers should watch after enabling bounds/predictive. Even if the dashboards live elsewhere, list metric names at a high level.

Irene Choi (author): Added 'What to monitor' section referencing desired vs bounded replicas and bound-hit counters (names as in the observability standards doc) without adding high-cardinality labels.
Ethan Park: Approved once CI is green.
release_notes: Terraform modules now support configuring Dedicated autoscaling bounds (min/max replicas) and predictive scaling mode.
New examples added for baseline capacity + budget ceiling and for predictive mode ramp handling.
Defaults preserve existing behavior unless scaling policy fields are explicitly set.
